completion_data.completion_summary: Created .claude/scripts/generate-todo.sh that generates entire TODO.md from state.json with YAML frontmatter, Task Order delegation to generate-task-order.sh, Tasks section with full entry formatting (status markers, artifact links, descriptions), atomic write via mktemp+mv, and append-only logging.

memory_candidates.content: When delegating to a sub-script via bash variable capture (`output=$(subscript --print)`), bash strips trailing newlines. If the sub-script's output must be followed by an explicit blank line separator in the parent output, always add `printf '\n'` after the `printf '%s\n'` that prints the captured output.

generate-task-order.sh --print does not accept --state flag; it uses its default PROJECT_ROOT/specs/state.json path. Only --update-todo mode accepts TODO and STATE file args. When calling --print, do not pass --state.
